entities.name: Mauricio Cardozo Ocampo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mauricio Cardozo Ocampo was a Paraguayan composer and singer. He was the main reference of the so-called "golden generation" of the Paraguayan popular music and a strict studious of the Paraguayan folk music.
